note: Single menu contract for the homepage, the Agent app and all generated pages. footer_groups only REFERENCE the drawer entries (home, agent, drawer groups), so header, drawer and footer share one vocabulary. Every published parent hub, category, available subtopic and static Page is linked with 2–3 word navigation labels; SEO titles and URL slugs never change.

drawer.note: Trang Web lists the config/site-pages.json pages without a group; Pháp Lý lists the pages with "group": "legal" (same registry, same order); Cẩm Nang resolves hubs > canonical categories > non-empty subtopics from data/blog/taxonomy.json and its url is the blog home (the one key for that URL: header, Tìm Bài, footer and breadcrumbs read it; the builder writes that page at blog/index.html); Dịch Vụ has verified contact actions. Agent chat keeps its reset control.

chat_extras.note: Chat-homepage-only utility appended AFTER the core drawer: a divider + the reset action. Never rendered on content pages.

svg_icons.note: Inline SVG icon names (tools/blog-components.mjs ICON_PATHS) for the app-style menus: desktop top level (>= 1180px) and the bottom tab bar.

tab_bar.note: App-style bottom tab bar (max 5 tabs) on phones and tablets (< 900px) of every content page, and in the Agent app wherever its desktop menu is hidden (replaces the v50 dock). Every tab REFERENCES an existing entry: home = navigation.home, blog = the Cẩm nang drawer group url, agent = navigation.agent; drawer tabs open the one shared drawer (a group id expands that group). No new URL, no second menu.
